comment: mklev.c mkstairs():2175-2181 impossible("mkstairs:  placing stairs %s on %s at <%d,%d>") for a square that is not ROOM, CORR or ICE. An elven Priest in debug mode level-teleports with ^V to the Plane of Water (the menu's 'K' entry), wishes for nothing, and runs #wizloadlua orcus, whose des.levregion() stair regions stay in gl.lregions because #wizloadlua runs no fixup_special(). #wizmakemap then regenerates water.lua, and mkmaze.c fixup_special() places those stair regions: put_lregion_here() accepts an air square (bad_location() allows AIR), so mkstairs() reports placing stairs on air. Seed, date, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
